Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂：盡乾坤大地，喚作一句子，擔枷帶鎖。不喚作一句子，業識茫茫。兩頭俱透脫，淨倮倮，赤灑灑，沒可把。達磨一宗，掃土而盡。所以雲門大師道：盡乾坤大地，無纖毫過患，猶是轉句。不見一法，始是半提。更須知有全提底時節。大小雲門，劍去久矣。方乃刻舟。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X84/X84n1585.xml). Drafts for the Continuation of the Lamp (續燈存稿). Speaker: Xiatang Huiyuan.

Senses.Explanation: A verdict of belatedness: the effective action or occasion has already passed while someone still tries to grasp or explain it. Several records join it to marking the boat only after the sword is gone. Dongshan Jue asks whether the assembly knows that the sword has long since gone before striking the seat and descending. Xiatang Huiyuan follows a Yunmen quotation with the verdict and the boat-marking image. Baichi Xingyuan, Yunwai Xingze, Xutang Zhiyu, and Dongsi Ruhui use the same formula in their own addresses or appraisals.
